sections.title: Section 79A — Power of State Government to give directions
sections.titleMr: कलम ७९(अ) — राज्य शासनाचे निर्देश देण्याचे अधिकार
sections.summary: The State Government may issue directives to a society in the public interest, after giving the society an opportunity to be heard. Almost the entire CHS redevelopment framework (consent percentages, developer selection, procedure) rests on 79A directives issued by GR — most recently the GR of 30 September 2026.
sections.summaryMr: सार्वजनिक हिताच्या दृष्टीने राज्य शासन संस्थेला संधी देऊन निर्देश देऊ शकते. गृहनिर्माण संस्थांच्या पुनर्विकासाची संपूर्ण यंत्रणा — संमती टक्केवारी, विकसक निवड, कार्यपद्धती — ७९(अ) अंतर्गतच्या शासन निर्णयांवर उभी आहे (सध्या ३० सप्टेंबर २०२६ चा निर्णय).

sections.title: Section 91 — Disputes (exclusive jurisdiction of the Co-operative Court)
sections.summary: Disputes touching the constitution, management or business of a society must go to the Co-operative Court — civil courts generally lack jurisdiction. For housing societies, member-vs-society disputes (including redevelopment decisions) route through 91. Society–developer contract disputes instead go to arbitration; the High Court also repeatedly relegates writ petitioners to their 91 remedy.
sections.summaryMr: संस्थेच्या रचना, व्यवस्थापन किंवा व्यवसायास स्पर्श करणारे वाद सहकारी न्यायालयातच जातात; दिवाणी न्यायालयाचा अधिकारक्षेत्र बहुतेक वर्जित. सभासद विरुद्ध संस्था (पुनर्विकास निर्णयांसह) — ९१; संस्था विरुद्ध विकसक करारवाद — लवादी. उच्च न्यायालय ९१ च्या पर्यायी उपायाकडे पाठवते.

sections.title: Section 154B-10 — Rights and duties of members

sections.titleMr: कलम १५४ब-२९ — देयके जमिनीच्या महसुलाच्या दादांप्रमाणे वसुली

misroutes.note: Sec 73-CA (two-children disqualification etc.) exists generally but is statutorily EXCLUDED for housing societies by Sec 154B(2). For CHS committee disqualification, the operative provision is Sec 154B-23.
Rule 58-A is the Form M-20 indemnity-bond rule — NOT disqualification — and the M-20 requirement was abolished in 2012. Disqualification of CHS committee members is governed by Sec 154B-23.
Sec 78 (supersession of a committee) is excluded for housing societies by Sec 154B(2). Administrator appointments for CHS run through Sec 77A.
Sec 101 recovery is excluded for housing societies by Sec 154B(2); recovery of society dues runs through Sec 154B-29 (Registrar's recovery certificate, revision under Sec 154).
Member rights and duties (including the redevelopment-critical duty to vacate, 154B-10(5)(ii)) live in Sec 154B-10 — not 154B-5.
154B-16 is about LEVY of maintenance/service charges — not 'transactions' as commonly assumed.

There is NO dedicated redevelopment-procedure section in the Act. Procedure lives in Sec 79A GR directives (2009 → 2019 → 2026) and Model Bye-law 65 — and courts have held these directives directory, not mandatory.
